caption.hook:
I came to El Salvador with pretty low expectations after visiting Guatemala and Nicaragua a few months earlier, and it ended up being one of my favorite experiences in Latin America. Tourism only really opened up in 2022, so there are no crowds, pupusas cost $0.60 and a bus ride is $0.75.

You can drive across the whole country in under 5 hours, so 10 days covers a lot: a volcano with a turquoise crater lake, the colonial towns of the Ruta de las Flores, the 7 Waterfalls hike (by far my favorite thing I did) and the surf beaches on the coast.
